limits_deviation: First two actual processes used CPU600/wall600/AS2GiB, contrary to subsequently read TASK CPU120/wall140 requirement. This is a real setup noncompliance, not corrected retroactively. Both returned immediately and no job survived. All subsequent local commands set CPU120, timeout140, AS6GiB and affinity {0,1} before filesystem/source reads.
limitations: ru_maxrss is OS process high-water RSS, not periodic sampled RSS. No affinity readback/query performed. Many early processes printed no rusage; no complete measured cap-compliance claim. AS was hard limited. Managed searches use service-side limits with no exposed local CPU/RSS receipt.
